subject: Exception request: one-time renewal concessions for GreenBridge Health
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, May 3, 2026 at 09:12 AM -0700
Subject: Exception request: GreenBridge Health renewal concessions

Team —

Quick context: GreenBridge (Enterprise, 450 seats) is in active renewal; deal is up for signature 5/15. They are pushing hard on price and alignment to their fiscal year (Sept), and procurement has threatened to pause the renewal if we don't provide a one-time concession package. They are strategic in health vertical (pilot for two large customer references).

What they are asking (summary):
- 25% first-year discount on hosted inference consumption
- $30,000 one-time onboarding credit (services/assistance)
- Agreement term reset to 9/30/2027 (align to their FY)
- SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime commitment + 10% of monthly fee credited for any SLA breach in first 12 months

Revenue impact: ~20% ACV reduction in year 1 if all approved (we retain full ARR thereafter). Renewal target ACV pre-concession: $1.2M.

Asking for: senior approval to offer a limited, one-time concession package (see attachments for numbers and current SOW). Proposed conservative counter (my recommendation): 20% discount first year, $20k onboarding credit, term reset to 9/30/27, SLA addendum with 5% credit cap.

Urgency: procurement escalated deadline to 5/10. Need an answer to preserve momentum.

Attachments: GreenBridge_Renewal_Summary.xlsx, GreenBridge_Current_SOW.pdf

Thanks — I can hop on a 15m to run through numbers.

— David
David Kim
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, May 4, 2026 at 10:08 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Exception request: GreenBridge Health renewal concessions

Thanks for the summary, David. A few operational notes before we escalate formally: 

- If we do 25% off list that's a material precedent in this segment; we should constrain it as a one-time, non-renewing concession tied to a signed addendum.
- Onboarding credit: prefer services credit (applied to professional services line) and not a cash rebate. That helps margins and limits accounting churn.
- Term reset: agree it's reasonable if we push for the customer to sign a 2-year term post-reset (so we don't lose visibility year-over-year).
- SLA: we need legal to sign a short addendum that caps payout (cap at 1 month of fees annually) and ties credit to verified incident postmortems. 10% monthly credit sounds open-ended.

Recommendation (final ask to leadership): Approve up to 20% discount first year, $20k services credit, term reset to 9/30/2027 conditioned on a 24-month total commitment from the reset date, SLA addendum with max payout equal to 5% monthly fee and requirement for incident review.

If Vivek can sign off on the financials I'm comfortable moving to procurement + legal. Rishi — please confirm impact on FY numbers and margin (cc'd).

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, May 4, 2026 at 02:31 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Exception request: GreenBridge Health renewal concessions

I've reviewed the numbers and the strategic rationale (reference potential + vertical momentum). Approve the concession package with the following binding conditions: 

1) Discount: cap at 20% off list for year 1 only.
2) Onboarding credit: $20,000 services credit applied to professional services (no cash).
3) Term reset: customer signs an addendum resetting to 9/30/2027 AND commits to a minimum 24-month term from reset date; early termination fee applies prorated for remaining months.
4) SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime; payout limited to a cumulative max of 5% of monthly fees per incident, and 1 month of fees per 12-month period. Trigger requires documented incident review with our SREs.
5) Legal to draft addenda reflecting the caps and commit to a 48-hour turnaround for review.

Rishi — please record the one-time concession in forecast as a sales credit event and confirm the impact on Q2 metrics. Once legal confirms wording I authorize David to send the commercial packet to the customer.

I will approve this via email; no additional finance forum required. Vivek
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@greenbridgehealth.com>, procurement@greenbridgehealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, May 5, 2026 at 09:22 AM -0700
Subject: GreenBridge — renewal package and next steps (per leadership approval)

Julia / Procurement team —

Thanks for the detailed conversations last week. Per our leadership review, Redwood is prepared to offer a one-time retention package to address GreenBridge's timing and implementation needs. Summary of approved terms (one-time, non-recurring unless otherwise noted):

- 20% discount on year 1 consumption charges (applies to hosted inference invoice line)
- $20,000 onboarding services credit (applied against professional services invoices)
- Agreement term reset to 2027-09-30 conditioned on a 24-month minimum term from the reset date
- SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime; credits limited to 5% of monthly fees per incident and an annual cap of one month's fees; credits issued only after incident review with SREs

Attached: GreenBridge_Renewal_Summary.xlsx, GreenBridge_Current_SOW.pdf. Legal will send the addendum reflecting the caps and conditional language within 48 hours. I have also created the HubSpot renewal record for signatures: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/54821/record/GBH-54821 and a DocuSign packet will follow: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123-GBH

Please confirm acceptance or send any narrow clarifying asks by EOD 5/10 so we can keep the existing pricing and onboarding timeline intact.

Best —
David Kim
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Julia Park <julia@greenbridgehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, procurement@greenbridgehealth.com
Date: Tue, May 5, 2026 at 04:42 PM -0700
Subject: Re: GreenBridge — renewal package and next steps (per leadership approval)

David —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and clarity. The package looks acceptable to GreenBridge leadership. Two quick asks before we sign: 
1) Can you confirm the onboarding credit can be used for training sessions with our implementation team?
2) We want the SLA addendum to include an operational contact for incident escalations — please include the SRE contact in the DocuSign packet.

If those two items are included we will route the packet to our CFO for signature this week.

Thanks — Julia Park
Head of Procurement, GreenBridge Health
